title: MMMUTRESO
description: A centralized platform for accessing study resources. MMMUTRESO offers a one-stop solution for students to find and utilize various educational materials and tools, simplifying the process of accessing and organizing study resources.
longDescription: MMMUTRESO is a comprehensive educational platform that serves as a central hub for students to access and organize their study materials. The platform features a user-friendly interface, advanced search capabilities, and organized categorization of resources.

title: Editify AI
description: A modern AI image generation and processing web application built with the MERN stack. It allows users to generate images from text and transform existing images using a suite of AI-powered tools.
longDescription: Editify AI is a full-stack MERN application that provides a comprehensive platform for AI-driven image manipulation. It integrates various APIs from Clipdrop to offer functionalities like text-to-image generation, object removal, background removal, and more. The application features a clean, responsive, and mobile-first user interface with smooth animations built using Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. It includes a complete user authentication system with JWT, a credit-based payment system integrated with Razorpay, and robust error handling.
features: JWT-based user authentication and credit system
Razorpay payment integration for credit top-ups
Robust error handling and loading states

title: AI Debate Simulator
description: A GenAI-powered web platform that simulates dynamic debates between two large language model (LLM) agents with contrasting personalities, leveraging Google's Gemini 2.0 Flash API. Users can choose topics and experience realistic, model-driven debate conversations enhanced with neural text-to-speech (TTS).
longDescription: The AI Debate Simulator is a full-stack conversational AI application that showcases the potential of large language models (LLMs) in structured debate scenarios. Powered by Google's Gemini 2.0 Flash model, it generates real-time multi-turn dialogues between two AI-driven personalities: a persuasive PROS agent and a critical CONS agent. The system features advanced GenAI capabilities including personality-driven prompting, context-aware rebuttals, and streaming responses. Integrated with neural text-to-speech (TTS) engines, the simulator delivers lifelike voice-based debates, enhancing immersion through differentiated voice profiles. This project demonstrates how LLMs can be orchestrated with frontend and backend engineering to create interactive, model-driven simulations.
features: LLM-powered debate generation with personality prompts
Dual GenAI agents (PROS vs CONS) with real-time rebuttals
Streaming conversation via REST API endpoints
Customizable debate topics and multi-round configuration
Responsive mobile-first React interface with animations
Human-like TTS with distinct male/female voices
Optional ElevenLabs integration for premium neural voices
Interactive playback and voice parameter customization

frontend.styling: Custom CSS with gradients and animations
frontend.tts: Web Speech API with voice selection

aiPersonalities.contextAwareness: Agents respond to each other's arguments in real-time

voiceConfiguration.prosAgent: Male voice, higher pitch, faster rate
voiceConfiguration.consAgent: Female voice, lower pitch, normal rate
voiceConfiguration.enhancedTTS: Optional ElevenLabs for premium voice models

conversation.speaker: pros
conversation.text: That's an excellent point! Technology is clearly revolutionizing how we work...

conversation.speaker: cons
conversation.text: I understand your enthusiasm, but let me point out some critical concerns...

customization.topics: Add topics via predefinedTopics array in App.tsx
customization.voiceSettings: Adjust rate, pitch, and volume in App.tsx

troubleshooting.apiKeyError: Ensure Gemini API key is in .env file
troubleshooting.voiceIssue: Check Web Speech API browser support

title: SWASTHMITRA
description: A platform for providing medical assistance to the needy. SWASTHMITRA offers a one-stop solution for providing medical assistance to the needy, simplifying the process of accessing and organizing medical resources.
longDescription: SWASTHMITRA is a comprehensive healthcare platform designed to bridge the gap between medical resources and those in need. The platform facilitates easy access to medical assistance, resource management, and coordination between healthcare providers and patients.

title: Real-time Distributed Chat System
description: A scalable real-time chat application enabling low-latency communication using a microservices architecture built with Next.js, Socket.IO, Redis, Apache Kafka, and PostgreSQL.
longDescription: The Real-time Distributed Chat System is a high-performance communication platform designed for scalable, low-latency messaging across distributed servers. It leverages Redis for message distribution, Apache Kafka for event processing, and PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM for persistent storage, all orchestrated through a microservices architecture.
features: Asynchronous event processing via Apache Kafka
Persistent storage with PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM
Secure communication with WebSocket authentication and message encryption
High availability through load balancing and server clustering

longDescription: PUSHPAKDRONEVIMAN is a specialized e-commerce platform catering to drone enthusiasts, IoT developers, and 3D printing professionals. The platform offers a comprehensive catalog of high-quality drones, components, and tools, with secure payment processing and efficient order management.

title: SEARCH PKMN (REACTJS)

longDescription: A Pokémon search application built with React.js. This tool allows users to search for and view information about various Pokémon with their images.

title: Graph Visualizer
description: An interactive graph visualization app to create, visualize, and traverse graphs with real-time algorithm animations like BFS and DFS.
longDescription: A beautiful, interactive graph visualization application built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. This application allows you to create, visualize, and traverse graphs in real-time with stunning visual effects. It includes live, step-by-step animations for Breadth-First Search (BFS) and Depth-First Search (DFS), making it a powerful educational tool for understanding graph algorithms.
features: Dynamic graph creation and management (2-50 nodes)
Interactive edge management with manual and adjacency list inputs
Interactive visualization with movable nodes and physics simulation
Live, animated graph traversals for BFS and DFS
Step-by-step visualization of queue/stack data structures during traversal
Educational display of traversal order and node/edge highlighting

title: File Explorer Pro
description: A feature-rich file explorer built with React, demonstrating advanced patterns like drag & drop, multiple view modes, and context menus.
longDescription: A modern, feature-rich file explorer application built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. This project demonstrates advanced React patterns and provides a comprehensive file management interface with intuitive navigation and powerful organizational tools. It showcases modern development practices including component composition, custom hooks, and centralized state management with the Context API, making it a great example for learning advanced React.
features: Interactive file system with create/delete/move operations
Switchable grid and list view modes
Seamless drag & drop support for files and folders
ASCII tree visualization of the file structure
Right-click context menus for quick actions
Responsive design with dark/light mode themes
